speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship.exposition: Use စောင့်ရှောက်မှုခံယူသူ for 利用者 and ကာယကံရှင် for 本人; keep all clinical and worker roles explicit.
speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship.worker_resident: Respectful adult Burmese with ပါ/ပါသလား and naturally omitted pronouns; retain preferred name and Japanese-san as စံ where address itself is taught.
speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship.colleagues: Respectful collegial Burmese; use named role or name when task ownership must stay explicit.
speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship.clinical_staff: သူနာပြု and ဆေးဘက်ဆိုင်ရာဝန်ထမ်း remain distinct from ပြုစုစောင့်ရှောက်ရေးဝန်ထမ်း.
speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship.family: Retain source family relationship only when stated; do not presume familial address.

address_forms_and_conditions.neutral: Omit unnecessary I/you in Burmese; do not supply gendered first-person pronouns when source does not identify speaker gender.
address_forms_and_conditions.resident: Use requested personal name plus စံ in Japanese-address exercises. Do not substitute Burmese kinship terms.
address_forms_and_conditions.permission: Use လို့ ရပါသလား/ပေးနိုင်မလား as context fits; preserve separate consent for acts and property.
address_forms_and_conditions.colleague: Keep named actor when assigning or repeating responsibility; neutral ကိုယ်တိုင် denotes the source speaker, not a new gender/age relation.
